description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book!• Private courtyard with dipping pool (21ft x 10ft) – heat optional add'l $50/night• Just Steps to Inlet Beach access* Beach Service Included!• 4 bikes included! • Porches and balcony with outdoor seating • Heated floors in living room and kitchen!• Kitchenette in second living area• Gated community with pool and grill• Walk or bike to Rosemary Beach• Professionally managed with 24/7 service*Guests must be 25+ to rent. No exceptions.*Casa del Mar is a stunning Spanish-style home featuring a newly designed private courtyard with a pool, grill, and outdoor dining area. Tucked within the gated Pinecrest community, this 5BR/5.5BA retreat offers over 2,800 sq. ft. of elegant living space. Inside, enjoy a spacious open floor plan with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and shiplap accents. The first-floor king suite includes a private ensuite bath, while the second floor offers three queen bedrooms (each with ensuite baths) and a twin bunk room, sleeping up to 10 guests. Driveway parking only – fits up to 3 cars. This inviting home blends luxury, location, and leisure in one perfect package. Come relax, explore, and make lasting memories at Casa del Mar — your serene getaway on the Emerald Coast. The beach is a short stroll away, and the community pool and grill area offer extra space to relax.Snorkelers will love exploring the Grouper Reef, located just 970 feet offshore from Inlet Beach access — a vibrant spot for sea life and underwater adventure.
